en: Black‑and‑white image showing a richly ornamented Baroque‑revival / historicist city palace on a corner square. The central building has a high mansard roof with decorative cresting, an ornate central portal reached by a broad double staircase, and elaborate window surrounds. On the left is another grand late‑19th‑century façade; behind, several church or public‑building spires rise above the roofs. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across a cobbled square in front of the building. No text is visible on the image.
